commands.name: Refactor Impact Analyzer
commands.prompt: What are the risks if I change this function/module? Where is it used and what might break?

commands.name: Change Safety Checklist
commands.prompt: Im planning to change [function/module]. Give me a checklist of tests, impacted files, and validations.

commands.name: Root Cause Tracing
commands.prompt: This broke in prod. Walk me through where I should start investigating and why.

commands.name: Backward Compatibility Guard
commands.prompt: Help me refactor this safely without breaking backward compatibility.

commands.name: Explain + Usage + Tests
commands.prompt: Explain what this does, where it's used, and suggest edge/boundary test cases.

commands.name: Cross-file Usage Tracker
commands.prompt: List all modules or components that use this function/service.

commands.name: Interface & Type Propagation
commands.prompt: If I modify this interface, where will it ripple across the app?

commands.name: Repo-Wide Risk Scan
commands.prompt: List all shared utilities and who uses them. Highlight critical paths or under-tested logic.

commands.name: Untested Paths Scanner
commands.prompt: Show me any critical but untested functions in this file/module.

commands.name: Monorepo Dependency Mapping
commands.prompt: In this monorepo, which packages depend on this module?

commands.name: Create Test Plan from Diff
commands.prompt: Here’s a code diff. Generate a test plan covering all major impacted areas.

commands.name: Autogenerate Commit Message
commands.prompt: Write a clear, meaningful commit message from this change.

commands.name: Write PR Description
commands.prompt: Summarize this PR with intent, risk, and impacted areas.

commands.name: Changelog Generator
commands.prompt: Convert this diff or commit history into a changelog entry.

commands.name: Act as Reviewer
commands.prompt: Act as a senior dev. Review this code for readability, performance, and maintainability.

commands.name: Teach Me Best Practices
commands.prompt: What are common mistakes when writing async functions in NodeJS?

commands.name: Architecture Coach
commands.prompt: Explain how this project’s folder structure supports scalability.
